notes: Profile: mid-market SaaS (product analytics). Heavy realtime support chat + periodic corpus reranking for search personalization.
Current provider: OpenAI (gpt-4x style + embeddings). Pain points: cost spikes, throttling at high concurrency, opaque token billing at route level.
Primary ask: run initial pilot on Redwood Hosted API to validate latency/cost and then migrate to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation.

Migration specifics: want a compatibility shim so minimal client changes. Key items: endpoint mapping, param parity (temperature, top_p, stop sequences), streaming & function-call behavior must match existing contracts.
Prompt parity work: create 'golden prompts' and sample inputs (6k utterances). Will run side-by-side diff with metrics: token cost delta, answer format tokens, hallucination rate, and semantic F1.
Regression policy: tolerate ≤3% delta on reranking NDCG@10 and ≤5% format/structure regressions for chat. Any larger regression triggers rollback and investigation.
POC scope: two production routes (chat support, semantic search);
POC success criteria (prelim): <120ms p50 token latency for chat in Hosted pilot, NDCG@10 within 98% of baseline, cost per 1M tokens at or below projected number in pricing deck.
Tech notes from SE call: KV/prefix cache behavior needs to be documented; they rely on stable tokenization and identical stop-sequence handling. Also need deterministic reranker seeds for eval runs.
Quote from Head of ML: 'If we can't get prompt parity and deterministic reranking, ops can't accept risk of drift.'
Suggested approach from Redwood SE: run A/B shadow traffic to detect regressions, use evaluation harness (Drive: /decks/zenithflow/prompt-evals-v1.xlsx) and gate with automated alerts.
Contract pulse: procurement requests a committed node quote for Dedicated (3x A100 equivalent) and a credit/trial structure for the Hosted POC. Legal flagged data residency for EU customers.
Team sentiment: product + infra enthusiastic; security is cautious — wants on-prem option if residency can't be satisfied via VPC regions.
